item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json, py_compile\\nfrom work import evaluate\\npy_compile.compile('work.py', doraise=True)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report == [evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]\\ndef ok(req, pol, cfg): assert evaluate(req,pol)=={'ok':True,'config':cfg,'error':None}\\ndef fail(req, pol, err): assert evaluate(req,pol)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':err}\\nbase={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}\\nok({'layers':[{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''}]},base,{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''})\\nok({'layers':[{'i':9},{'i':None}]},base,{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'})\\nok({'layers':[{'i':'bad'}],'environment':{'i':'-12','b':'false','s':''}},base,{'b':False,'i':-12,'s':''})\\nfail({'layers':[{'x':1}]},base,'unknown_key')\\nfail({'environment':{'x':'1'}},base,'unknown_key')\\nfail({'environment':{'b':'True'}},base,'environment')\\nfail({'environment':{'i':' 1'}},base,'environment')\\nfail({'environment':{'i':'1.0'}},base,'environment')\\nfail({'layers':[{'i':True}]},base,'type')\\nfail({'environment':{'i':'1'}},{**base,'environment':False},'environment')\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
